description: Run folders with a timestamp (W4.4): each case is signing-v1's signed folder (`bundle`), with `files` added, replaced ({"text"} or {"base64"}) or removed (null), the public key `public_key` of signing-v1/keys.json, and as the TSA's CA the PEM `tsa_ca` names in timestamp-v1/keys.json (`root`, `other_root`, `tsa_certificate`, or `both_roots`: the other root and then the root), or none (null). `expect` is the word both verifiers answer; with `verified`, `timestamp` is the third field of their line, `verified <bundle_sha256> key <key_id> timestamp <timestamp>`. The tokens are the test-only TSA's and stamp 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z; a chain is checked at the token's own time, so they never expire. Written once by the Worker's hidden test `rptests "[.write_shared_timestamp]"`; ECDSA makes every run's tokens different, so the file is verified by both builds and never regenerated in a test.
